In detail

Torrino is a mixed residential and commercial neighbourhood near EUR, with offices, apartment blocks and shopping streets. Press coverage shows routine property crime alongside a documented, localized decay problem on Via Stoccolma, where residents have petitioned the city over prostitution, illegal dumping and unsafe street conditions. These are real but geographically limited concerns rather than a district-wide pattern, so daytime Torrino is green while night is rated yellow.
